posts.text: My 2 Cents on the Business Given the nature of a platform business, I think it’s difficult to make much sense of the valuation if we only look at what the business has today. I think the better way to look at it is what this business can potentially become. For a business like Groww, I would look at it over a 5–10 year horizon rather than getting too caught up in the current numbers. For example, look at MTF as a % of market cap - India is at ~0.29% vs. ~0.55% in Korea and ~2.0% in the US. So, at least on the MTF side, I think there is still a pretty long runway for growth. posts.text: BusinessLine – 8 Sep 26 Groww adds 2.23 lakh active clients in August, market share tops 29% Among the larger brokers, SBI Securities is the only one to report a decline, losing around 26,200 active clients and taking its base to 10.4 lakh Groww added roughly 2.23 lakh net active clients in August, taking the market share past 29% of NSE active clients for the first time. Steady upward trend through 2026 — Groww’s share moved from about 27.7% in January, to 28.3% by March, to 28.7-28.9% through June-July, and now past 29% in August.
